answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity accumulates a rolling behavioural hash—transaction timing, counterparty mix, response latency—sampled at random intervals per epoch, like a comet tracked across successive orbits. An identity whose fingerprint jumps discontinuously between epochs (new cluster of counterparties, shifted timing profile) is flagged like a raven changing roost overnight, and its cross-epoch weight decays toward a faint nebula until continuity is re-earned.
